# Vendored JavaScript libraries

All assets in `web/static/vendor/` are redistributed under their original licenses
to keep the board CSP-safe (no CDN, no runtime fetch) and to make a plain
`go build` sufficient — see `docs/PLAN.md` §4 and §9.

## Generated CSS — `app.css`

- Generated by the Tailwind CSS v4 standalone CLI (`make css`) from sources
  authored in this repository (`web/templates/*.html`). No third-party CSS is
  redistributed here; the binary itself is **not** vendored — see `Makefile`.
